plugins.name: ai-native-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills for AI-native development: /assess (codebase readiness scoring, complexity hotspot SVG and doc-navigability graph), /huddle (Six Thinking Hats deliberation with Fibonacci team sizing), /deslop, /skill-forge, /semantic-compress, /ghsync and /ghreport (clone and report on every GitHub or GitLab repo you can access), /fleet (headless /assess signals across many repositories, rolled up per group) and /doc-contradictions (finds docs that contradict each other or the code). Also bundles user-invoked personal workflow skills (/tm, /issues, /fix-pr, /fix-develop).
